description: This file declares the ActiveRequests class, which manages active media requests within the Rialto server component. It includes nested class ActiveRequestsData for handling individual request data, and provides methods for inserting, erasing, and retrieving requests and their segments.

classes.name: ActiveRequests
classes.description: Manages active media requests, allowing insertion, removal, and segment management.

classes.name: ActiveRequests::ActiveRequestsData
classes.description: Holds data for a specific media request, including its type, segments, and byte counts.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Adds a new media request with specified type and maximum media bytes, returning a request ID.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the media source type associated with a given request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a request by its ID or by media source type.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to a specific request identified by request ID.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Retrieves all media segments associated with a specific request ID.
